title: WIPPES Act

claims.claim: Establishes a Do Not Flush labeling regime for premoistened, nonwoven disposable wipes marketed as baby or diapering wipes.
claims.sourceSpan: a premoistened, nonwoven disposable wipe sold or offered for retail sale

claims.claim: Also covers household or personal-care wipes composed entirely or in part of petrochemical-derived fibers and having significant potential to be flushed.
claims.sourceSpan: is composed entirely, or in part, of petrochemical-derived fibers

claims.claim: Covered inclusions include antibacterial and disinfecting wipes.
claims.sourceSpan: antibacterial wipes and disinfecting wipes

claims.claim: Covered inclusions include general and bathroom cleaning wipes.
claims.sourceSpan: wipes intended for general purpose cleaning or bathroom cleaning, including toilet cleaning and hard surface cleaning

claims.claim: Covered inclusions include body/personal-care wipes such as hand sanitizing, makeup removal, feminine and adult hygiene, and body cleansing.
claims.sourceSpan: wipes intended for personal care use on the body, including hand sanitizing, makeup removal, feminine hygiene, adult hygiene (including incontinence hygiene), and body cleansing

claims.claim: Covered entities are manufacturers, wholesalers, suppliers, individuals, or retailers responsible for the labeling or retail packaging of a covered product sold or offered for retail sale in the United States.
claims.sourceSpan: a manufacturer, wholesaler, supplier, individual or group of individuals, or retailer that is responsible for the labeling or retail packaging of a covered product that is sold or offered for retail sale in the United States
